description: A side-by-side table of how 2 to 10 countries regulate prostitution: the legal model and the status of each chosen question (default: selling, buying, brothels, procuring, advertising), with a link to each full profile.

countries.description: The countries to compare (names or ISO codes).

items.description: Country name in English or the local language, or its ISO 3166 code: "Germany", "Deutschland", "DE", "DEU", "United States", "UK".

topics.description: The questions to compare (default: selling, buying, brothels, procuring, advertising). One of: selling (selling sexual services), buying (buying sexual services), brothels (brothels and managed venues), sharedPremises (sex workers sharing premises), procuring (third parties profiting (procuring / pimping)), advertising (advertising sexual services), platforms (online platforms and ad sites), street (street-based sex work and soliciting), registration (registration, licensing and health checks), tax (tax and social security), migrants (migrant sex workers).

name: compare_countries
title: Compare prostitution laws between countries
